Define the scope of a scoped page

Source: R/layout-scoped_page.R
cd_scope.Rd

A scope says at which geography a page runs its analysis: which admin level and region filters the page shows, and what admin level and region it hands to the analysis. Pages that run the same analysis at a different geography (national coverage and sub-national coverage, for example) differ only in their scope. Pass the result to cd_scoped_page_ui() and cd_scoped_page_server(), or to cd_scope_filters() and cd_scope_server().

Usage

cd_scope(
  kind = c("national", "level", "region", "level_region"),
  fixed_level = NULL,
  show_district = FALSE
)

Arguments

kind

The kind of scope: "national" (the default), "level", "region" or "level_region".

fixed_level

An admin level (for example "district") handed to the analysis in place of the level of the filter bar. NULL (the default) hands over the level of the filter bar. A "national" scope ignores it.

show_district

Logical. For kind = "level_region", whether a district can be chosen as the region. Other kinds ignore it. Default FALSE.

Value

A list with the elements kind, fixed_level and show_district, as given.

Details

The kinds of scope:

  • "national": no filters. The analysis gets the admin level "national" and no region.

  • "level": an admin level chip only (admin level 1 or district). The analysis gets the chosen level and no region.

  • "region": a region chip only, listing the admin level 1 areas. The analysis gets the chosen area and the admin level "adminlevel_1", or fixed_level when it is given.

  • "level_region": an admin level chip and a region chip. The region chip is shown at admin level 1, and also at the district level when show_district is TRUE.

Examples

cd_scope()
#> $kind
#> [1] "national"
#> 
#> $fixed_level
#> NULL
#> 
#> $show_district
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
cd_scope("region", fixed_level = "district")
#> $kind
#> [1] "region"
#> 
#> $fixed_level
#> [1] "district"
#> 
#> $show_district
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
cd_scope("level_region", show_district = TRUE)
#> $kind
#> [1] "level_region"
#> 
#> $fixed_level
#> NULL
#> 
#> $show_district
#> [1] TRUE
#>
